ABOUT THE HOME: Beauty and the Beach is located in the lovely Grande Pointe community within Inlet Beach. This four-level home has everything you could hope for in a vacation home by the sea, with four bedrooms, four full bathrooms and two half baths. The third floor features a game room with a pool table, fridge and wet bar but don't stop there, head on up to the fourth floor to relax on the amazing deck and enjoy the incredible gulf views. This home is a stunner and one you will want to visit year after year!

ABOUT THE AREA: Grande Pointe community is located in Inlet Beach and offers the tranquility you need to rejuvenate from your busy life yet experience as many activities as you desire along our stunning Emerald Coast. This coastal community has a saltwater pool and a dock right on Lake Powell where you can launch your paddle board, kayak, canoe, jet skis or fishing poles. There are many options for food and shopping at 30Avenue shop, which are just around the corner.

BEACH ACCESS: There are four public beaches just a short distance away. Right across Highway 98 is Inlet Beach Access! Visit www.sowal.com for more information on beaches, 30A communities and restaurants.

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 10
• Bedroom 1 - 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 – 1 King, ensuite
• Bunk Room – 2 Full/Full bunks and singles, hallway bath
• Bedroom 4 – 1 Queen, ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Gas Grill – Propane
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Community Pool (unheated)
• 2 Bikes
• Master on Main
• Pool table
• Outdoor 4th floor living room with TV
• Smart TVs in every bedroom
• Coffee Maker – pods and drip
• Full linen package: bedding & bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we’re at your fingertips!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida’s famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you’ll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2 parking spaces and a garage.

This is a smoke-free property. Violation of the no-smoking policy will result in forfeiture of the security deposit, a $300 smoking fee, and liability for any fire or property damage costs.

As part of our commitment to being good neighbors, occupancy limits and quiet hours (9pm-8am) are strictly enforced. No speakers or sound systems will be provided for use in our properties. Violation of any noise ordinances will be subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.

Events or parties are not allowed without prior written approval and an additional fee. Any unauthorized parties or events will be shut down and a fine will be assessed. Please inquire for more information about our event policies and fees.

There is nothing more important to us at AvantStay than the health, safety, and experience of our guests & staff. We've enhanced our cleaning and sanitation protocols and are taking extra care to disinfect all surfaces between reservations with hospital-grade disinfecting solutions.

As a reminder, we do work with 3rd party vendors to maintain the property, and although we adhere to the strictest CDC guidelines and advise all contractors to wear PPE equipment, we can not always enforce. We strongly advise guests to please deny access if any vendors fail to meet and adhere to these standards.

IDs will be requested for verification after booking. All bookings over 28 days require a security deposit.

We report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.author: Larry C.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: 30a beach girls is amazing to work with! Thank you for the beautiful home and exceptional service. We can't wait to return. This home is spectacular. The roof top terrace is amazing! The views every night were our favorite evening activity.
reviews.title: Loved it!

reviews.author: Jason S.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: This property lived up to the reviews - very spacious and beautifully decorated- stunning views from the sundeck! Plenty of space to relax when weather didn't cooperate, easy access to beach it's right across the road and over a block golf cart made it simple, large community pool area, house is so close to many excellent restaurants (Amicci was our fave) everyone at 30a beach girls quickly responded to questions - excellent place we will be back this summer!
reviews.title: House is a dream!

reviews.author: Ginger C.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Great and amazing house! Beautiful view! House was clean and well maintained. Hollie, Jada and Daisy was very responsive when we had questions. We were in need of sheets after my daughter had an accident and they got them to us ASAP in the middle of the night. Great place to stay and beach was beautiful! We will return.
reviews.title: Amazing home with an amazing view!

reviews.author: Dee G.
reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: Great place, stunning. If you have a picky group this home is the perfect place to stay. It was 8 of us from little kids to adults and we all had a great time. The kids loved the community pool and being a short walk to the beach and the adults loved played pool every night and the all enjoyed the beautiful view this home has to offer. You won't want to miss it each evening. Perfect ending to each day. Everyone at 30a beach girls is very nice and was very communicative if we couldn't figure something out. Worth a stay if you are looking for views and an over all good location close to shopping and dining. You can ride the cart and bikes everywhere you want to go.
reviews.title: Impressive home with a stellar view.

reviews.author: Julia and David B.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response: Wonderful time for wonderful guests! So thrilled you and your family enjoyed your stay at Beauty and the Beach. We hope to host you again. Thank you for the 5 stars! Sincerely, Hollie & 30a Beach Girls

reviews.text: I'm not sure where to start - everything about our week in 30a Beach Girls house was excellent. The house is very clean, organized, has two kitchens! House is beautiful - great views from the decks- the bedrooms are a great size, all king beds and easily accommodated my extended family. We ate almost every meal on the 2nd floor main living space deck. 30a Beach Girls has thought of everything. Beach towels, beach chairs, bicycles, ping pong, photo vw bus (free), bonfire... There is nothing I could think to add to this house. Thank you for sharing your home. We will definitely be back. I would highly recommend this home. We especially enjoyed - Old Florida Fish House - but our fav is Pescado but ask Hollie for sitter recommendations no kids at this restaurant. The best night was a perfect sunset on the beach with our bonfire, priceless! 30a BeachGirls made us a special smores board! Incredible. Can't wait for next year!! ~ Julia
reviews.title: Perfect Home- Outstanding hosts
